nodes.desc: WTP raw-water inlet · raw-main terminal · 199.5 MLD

raw_main.note: Raw water flows intake → WTP; treated water flows R-1 / PMP-1 → trunk → WDC tapping points. Flow = 190 MLD + 5% process losses (SIMULATED until intake pump duty supplied). Intake end follows the IFC MS 2000 mm pipe on the trestle (invert +24.63 m, dropping to +21.72 m at the landward end) and joins the WaterGEMS alignment 2.7 m beyond.
